messages:
noelle: Heads up — the top pantry shelf light/timer is tripping and the granola boxes keep getting stale. noticed it this morning, twice. anyone else? :frowning:
maya: yep saw that yesterday. thought it was just me killing the switch when I reached for the olive oil :grimacing:
devin: could be the motion sensor or the outlet. I can swing by after lunch and poke at it. do you want me to bring sealed tins for stuff temporarily?
noelle: that would be awesome. also someone keeps putting open oats on the high shelf without sealing. can we do a tiny labeling/tagging thing? maybe a sticker that says "open" with date.
sam: labeling + a small airtight bin = solved. i have a bunch of clear plastic bins at home, can drop 3 tomorrow morning :thumbsup:
harriet: if we do labels, can we make them wipeable? whiteboard marker + date would be easiest.
ellie: I made a quick suggestion for a weekly kitchen check in the #people-ops checklist. ops-bot added it to reminders.
ops-bot: Reminder set: Kitchen quick-check every Monday at 10:00 — rotate who checks shelf seals, expiry dates, and label clarity. (added by ellie)
maya: also pro tip — keep an Aeropress filter tin in the top drawer so the coffee doesn't get damp when the shelf light is on. it helps with that weird humidity from the toaster area.
devin: lol aeropress heroics. i can bring a small desiccant pack too. where should stuff live? label "communal" vs "personal"?
noelle: communal/personal is great. maybe a colored sticker system: blue = communal, red = personal. quick and visual.
harriet: here’s a tiny schedule snippet i hacked together:
```
Mon: check seals + reseal bags
Wed: wipe shelf + replace desiccant if soggy
Fri: check expiry labels
```
can pin it on the inside of the pantry door.
sam: vote: should we add a pantry-budget jar for replacement snacks? :coin:
noelle: +1 for a tiny budget. i can start with $10 this week.
ellie: thanks noelle! will update the checklist and pin the schedule.
maya: thanks everyone — devin, if you can bring tins and desiccant that would be perfect. i'll bring the label stickers.
ops-bot: devin updated: "brings sealed tins and desiccant" scheduled for 2061006000. :robot_face:
noelle: perfect. also, whoever left the half bag of pistachios on the floor — please claim them :laughing:
sam: not me. probably the office gremlin. :ghost:
maya: tiny victory: coffee beans in the big hopper are now sealed. saved a morning. :tada:
